steps: Create a second GDScript through the built-in script starter, edit its ordinary TXT draft and Save; only its source and registration are added.

Manage existing behavior finds the saved manifest and its used script. Preview reviews exactly one new script reference; Cancel writes nothing. Chinese, English and Japanese at 390px retain the selection/review and all footer and return controls without horizontal overflow.

Save reference uses the real relation.add transaction and changes exactly the manifest registration. Scene, behavior text, scripts and assets remain byte-identical; the new script is shown as available but unused and cannot be added twice.

Open behavior source performs guarded navigation into the ordinary editor. The independent behavior editor now offers the linked script, adds a third stable binding with typed parameters and a signal, and retains both existing bindings. Apply edits only the draft; ordinary Save changes only the behavior source.

The existing and newly linked scripts drive real Godot plan → build → headless run: three stable bindings produce east/40, west/20 and linked_in_studio/35 with their declared signal aliases and instances.

The resulting generated project is inspected, delivered through a real browser download, independently verified and extracted, then imported by real Godot at a new location. Scripts and image resources are present; no further author writes occur.
